MountRequired.description:
Specifies that the database MUST be successfully mounted at startup.
0 - Successful mount not required for startup to succeed.
1 - Successful mount required for startup to succeed.

MountAtStartup.description:
On a clustered system, specifies whether the database should be mounted at startup.
This property is valid for cluster systems only, and is ignored for non-cluster systems.
False - Don't mount at startup
True - Mount at startup

ClusterMountMode.description:
Database is configured to be mounted in cluster mode
If this property is set then this database has to be mounted explicitly.

Directory.description: Directory where the database resides. On ECP Clients of a mirror this contains logical references to the databases on the failover mirror members as the path may be different on the various nodes.

Server.description:
Name of the remote server where the DB resides.
If empty, the database is local.
Remote server must already be configured to be entered here.

StreamLocation.description:
Directory where the streams associated with this database go.
By default (value=""), the location is in the subdirectory "stream", underneath the database directory, e.g. for a database located in c:\abc, the default would be c:\abc\stream. InterSystems recommends leaving this parameter as "".

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id of a Task

result.description: All fields are required in the request body of a POST request to create a new task, except for the Settings field. All fields are optional in the body of a PUT request.

Name.description: Name of the task. Must be 50 characters or less, first character must be a letter. Note that Names longer than 50 characters will be truncated.

RunAsUser.description:
Username of user to run as.
A user must have the %Admin_Secure:Use privilege to define a task to run as another user.

EmailOnCompletion.description: A list of email addresses to send a completion notification to.

EmailOnError.description: A list of email addresses to send an error notification to.

EmailOnExpiration.description: A list of email addresses to send notification if the task expires.

EmailOutput.description: If an output directory and output file are chosen, and EmailOutput is set to true the output from the entry will be emailed to the email addresses in the EmailOnCompletion property.

Expires.description: Whether this entry expires. Expiration is only checked if this flag is set to true. Expiration is determined by whichever is first: 1) The current time passed the next submit time. 2) Expiration Offsets (Days, Hours, Minutes).

OpenOutputFile.description: If the output from the executed code is to be directed to an outputfile, open the output file.  If the executed code handles the open and close this value should be 0.

OutputDirectory.description: If an output directory and output file are chosen, the output from the entry will be directed there.

OutputFilename.description: If an output directory and output file are chosen, the output from the entry will be directed there. Note that if OutputDirectory is blank, this may contain the full file name.

OutputFileIsBinary.description: When emailing the output file this flag will indicate if the file should be sent as binary

SuspendOnError.description:
Option to suspend a Task if it encounters an error during a run. By default the Task is just rescheduled for its next run.

Note that this only applies to errors returned by the OnTask method. Errors encountered in Task Manager code will suspend the Task.

SuspendTerminated.description:
Option to suspend a Task if it has been terminated by a system shutdown. By default the Task is just rescheduled for its next run at startup.

Note that this only applies to Tasks that are found 'terminated' at startup.

TaskClass.description: A class in the specified 'NameSpace' which inherits from %SYS.Task.Definition

IsBatch.description:
Batch mode restricts the job to a small section of the buffer pool.
false - Don't run in batch mode (default)
True - Run in batch mode

NameSpace.description: Namespace to run the task in (default="%SYS")

TimePeriod.description:
Time period to run the task.
This property governs how the properties TimePeriodEvery and TimePeriodDay are interpreted

Valid parameters For TimePeriod are

0 - DAILY
TimePeriodEvery - Run every x Days, where Days are 1-7
TimePeriodDay - Set to "", ignored

1 - WEEKLY
TimePeriodEvery - Run every x Weeks, where weeks are 1-5
TimePeriodDay - Run on days xxxx, where Sunday=Day 1,Saturday=Day 7
(where 23456 would be Monday thru Friday)

2 - MONTHLY
TimePeriodEvery - Run every x Months, where months are 1-12
TimePeriodDay - Run on day x, where day=1-31, where 31=last day of month

3 - MONTHLYSPECIAL
TimePeriodEvery - Run every x Months, where months are 1-12
TimePeriodDay - week^day, where week is 1-5, 5 being last, day is 1-7, sunday is day 1

4 - RUNAFTER - Run this task after another task completes
TimePeriodEvery - (not used)
TimePeriodDay - 0
RunAfterGUID - JobGUID of Task to follow

5 - ONDEMAND - The task is set up. It can be run On Demand by calling the RunOnce method
TimePeriodEvery - "",ignored
TimePeriodDay - "", ignored
The user calls the RunOnce Class method to schedule the task after it is set up

If the Time period fields are not set when a task is created, the task is set by default to be run every day.

Examples:

Run every day
TimePeriod=0,TimePeriodEvery=1,TimePeriodDay=""

Run every other day
TimePeriod=0,TimePeriodEvery=2,TimePeriodDay=""

Run every Sunday
TimePeriod=1,TimePeriodEvery=1,TimePeriodDay=1

Run every Monday through Friday
TimePeriod=1,TimePeriodEvery=1,TimePeriodDay=23456

Run every other Saturday
TimePeriod=1,TimePeriodEvery=2,TimePeriodDay=7

Run the first day of every month
TimePeriod=2,TimePeriodEvery=1,TimePeriodDay=1

Run the last day of every month
TimePeriod=2,TimePeriodEvery=1,TimePeriodDay=31

Run the last day of every other month
TimePeriod=2,TimePeriodEvery=2,TimePeriodDay=31

Run the second Saturday of every month
TimePeriod=3,TimePeriodEvery=1,TimePeriodDay=2^7

Run the first Sunday of every month
TimePeriod=3,TimePeriodEvery=1,TimePeriodDay=1^1

Run after task BACKUP completes
TimePeriod=4,RunAfterGUID=BackupJobGUID,TimePeriodDay=0

Task is not scheduled to run. Task is scheduled to run by calling the RunOnce method.
TimePeriod=5,TimePeriodEvery="",TimePeriodDay=""

TimePeriodEvery.description: See TimePeriod property for legal values

TimePeriodDay.description: See TimePeriod property for legal values

DailyFrequency.description:
How often each day to run the task.
This property governs how the properties DailyFrequencyTime, DailyIncrement, DailyStartTime, and DailyEndTime are interpreted.

Valid parameters for DailyFrequency are:

0 - ONCE - Run once on the day scheduled
DailyFrequencyTime - "", ignored
DailyIncrement - "", ignored
DailyStartTime - Time for task to run
DailyEndTime - "",ignored

1 - SEVERAL - Run Several times in a day
DailyFrequencyTime - 0 - Run every x minutes
DailyFrequencyTime - 1 - Run every x hours
DailyIncrement - # of minutes between runs or # of hours between runs
DailyStartTime - Time for tasks to start running
DailyEndTime - Time for task to stop running

DailyFrequencyTime.description: See DailyFrequency property for legal values

DailyIncrement.description: See DailyFrequency property for legal values

DailyStartTime.description: See DailyFrequency property for legal values

DailyEndTime.description: See DailyFrequency property for legal values

RunAfterGUID.description: Execute this job when specified job completes

StartDate.description:
When to schedule the task first
Default is to start tomorrow

EndDate.description:
When to stop scheduling the task
Default is to never stop scheduling

MirrorStatus.description:
Used to control the execution of tasks when the system is part of a Mirror. Tasks may be scheduled to run on each Mirror Member, but will only be executed if the current status matches what is indicated by this property. This property is ignored by the Task Manager if the system is not a Mirror member.
Status = 1 - run only on Primary Mirror member (default)
Status = 2 - run only on a Non-Primary Mirror member
Status = 3 - run on Any Mirror member regardless of status

RescheduleOnStart.description:
If true, when the CheckSchedule class method is called with SystemStart=1 any jobs pending in the task queue will be removed, and rescheduled for their next time. For example, the journal switch is scheduled for midnight. If the system goes down at 11 pm, and then restarts at 1 am, the journal switch would normally run. But since we just started, we don't really want it to switch, so we reschedule it for the next time.
Default=0

Settings.description: The settings associated with the TaskClass. This is an arbitrary object and the relevant keys depend on the TaskClass.

/v2/task/info.privileges: (%Admin_Operate:U) View non-configurable info about a task, such as when it last finished or last started

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id of a Task

LastSchedule.description: When the task was last scheduled to run. "" - Never run

LastStarted.description: When the task was last started. "" - Never started

LastFinished.description: When the task was last finished. "" - did not finish

Status.description:
Return value of the method %OnTask.

If not defined by the task default success will be 1
If the job is currently running (JobRunning) Status will be -1
If there was an untrapped error (JobUntrappedError) Status will be -2
If there was an error before execution (JobSetupError) Status will be -3
If the task timed out trying to job (JobTimeout) Status will be -4
If there was an error after execution (JobPostProcessError) Status will be -5
The text of the status code will be in the property Error.

Error.description: Untrapped error from User task, or "Success"

Type.description: Type 'System' and 'Maintenance' are reserved for System Tasks. This gets assigned by the system when a task is specified.

NextScheduled.description: When the task is next scheduled to run.
